description: KL-27 is the Sub Regional Transport Office (SRTO) serving Thiruvalla in the Pathanamthitta district of Kerala. Established in 2006, it functions under the jurisdiction of the Regional Transport Office (KL-03) Pathanamthitta and manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the Thiruvalla Taluk.
address: Revenue Tower, Opposite Police Station, Head Post Office, Thiruvalla, Pathanamthitta, Kerala
